meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: NGS 测序数据分析工具包。装上后,Claude 能用 deepTools 命令把 BAM 转成 bigWig/bedGraph,做质控(相关性、PCA、指纹),生成热图和剖面图,并借助自带脚本校验文件、生成工作流脚本。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 等测序数据,或提出 BAM 转 bigWig、质控、样本比较、生成热图/图谱等任务时触发。

say.text: 把 sample.bam 转成 bigWig,用 RPGC 归一化。
对我的 ChIP 样本做质控:相关性、PCA 和指纹图。
在 TSS 周围画热图和剖面图。

howto.what_en: NGS data analysis toolkit. Once installed, Claude can run deepTools commands to convert BAM to bigWig/bedGraph, perform QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and generate heatmaps/profiles, plus use bundled scripts to validate files and generate workflow templates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq or other NGS data, or requests tasks such as BAM-to-bigWig conversion, QC, sample comparison, or heatmap/profile generation.

say_en.text: Convert sample.bam to bigWig, normalized with RPGC.
Run QC on my ChIP samples: correlation, PCA and fingerprint.
say_en.note: Uses multiBamSummary with plotCorrelation, plotPCA, plotFingerprint.

say_en.text: Draw a heatmap and profile around TSS.
